title: Ceiling on a Late Fee by the Time Since the Last Payment
content:
# Ceiling on a Late Fee by the Time Since the Last Payment

The ceiling on a late fee raised on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects rises the longer the owner's account has stayed silent.

## Rule

Where nothing has been paid on the project for 90 days or more, the ceiling on the fee is **10 per cent** of the amount the fee is taken on.

Where nothing has been paid on the project for more than 30 days but fewer than 90, the ceiling is **5 per cent** of that amount.

Where a payment has been received on the project within the last 30 days, or no payment has yet been received on it, the ceiling is **2 per cent** of that amount.

## The two boundaries

The days are counted from the most recent payment received on the project to the day the fee is raised. Exactly 30 days is not more than 30 and takes the lowest ceiling; 31 days is more than 30 and takes the middle one; exactly 90 days is 90 or more and takes the highest. A project on which no payment has ever been received takes the lowest ceiling.

| Days since the last payment | Ceiling on the fee |
|---|---|
| no payment ever received | 2 per cent |
| 12 | 2 per cent |
| 30 | 2 per cent |
| 31 | 5 per cent |
| 89 | 5 per cent |
| 90 | 10 per cent |
| 200 | 10 per cent |

## Worked ceilings (hypothetical amount of USD 150000)

Last payment 12 days ago: USD 3000.00. Last payment 60 days ago: USD 7500.00. Last payment 120 days ago: USD 15000.00.
